title: BAGMAN MailboxSweepRun
description: One durable sweep-attempt ledger row for a single `MailboxSource` (CD-6 Slice 4). Mirrors `services.xero.sync.XeroSyncRun`'s own role for the Xero domain: a terminal record of exactly what one sweep attempt did, never SUCCEEDED if a message that should have ingested failed irrecoverably.

sweep_run_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this sweep attempt.

trigger.description: `MANUAL` — an operator clicked 'Sweep now'. `SCHEDULED` — the optional dedicated worker (see `services/mailbox/sweep.py`'s module docstring for whether this slice built one).

status.description: `SUCCEEDED` — every folder's delta round completed and every discovered message reached a durably-handled terminal record (ingested, quarantined, or a governed vanished/oversize outcome). `PARTIAL` — at least one folder/message hit a transient failure but at least one other folder/message succeeded; the affected folder's cursor is NOT advanced. `FAILED` — nothing durable was accomplished this run (e.g. token refresh failed before any folder could even be attempted).

folder_id.description: The provider's own real, immutable folder identifier — the canonical value; never a display name.

display_name.description: Human-readable label for GUI/operator rendering only.

completed.description: Operational addendum. Whether this folder's delta round finished durably this run — i.e. contributed to a cursor advance — as opposed to a transient failure that left it un-advanced this round. Optional (not `required` below): only `run_sweep` itself populates it; a hand-built `folders_attempted` entry (e.g. an older/narrower test fixture) may omit it.

messages_seen.description: Operational addendum. Messages observed in THIS folder's delta pages this run (a per-folder breakdown of the run-level `messages_seen` total). Optional — see `completed`'s own note.

new_discovery_records.description: Operational addendum. Messages newly seen in THIS folder this run — i.e. `MailboxMessageRepository.record_observation` returned `is_new=True` (a per-folder breakdown of the run-level `messages_new` total). Optional — see `completed`'s own note.

deep_processing_count.description: Operational addendum. Messages in THIS folder that went through the ALLOWED-domain path this run and had a full MIME fetch attempted (whether it was then ingested, quarantined, or governed-failed as oversized). Optional — see `completed`'s own note.

cursor_established.description: Operational addendum. Whether a durable `MailboxFolderCursor` row now exists for this folder after this run, regardless of whether it was pre-existing or newly bootstrapped this run (distinct from `completed`, which additionally requires the round to have finished and the cursor's own `delta_link` to have advanced). Optional — see `completed`'s own note.

folders_attempted.description: CD-6 architect amendment (recursive folder discovery) + operational addendum (per-folder operational counts). Which folders this run actually attempted — now the REAL, per-mailbox discovered/monitored folder set (Inbox, Junk Email, Deleted Items, every custom/nested/hidden folder discovered; never Sent Items/Drafts/Outbox), not a hardcoded two-value list. Each entry carries both the canonical folder id and a human-readable display name so a GUI never has to render a raw opaque Graph folder id as if it were a friendly name, plus (from the operational addendum) per-folder operational counts populated by `run_sweep` itself — see each sub-field's own description.

messages_seen.description: Total messages observed across every attempted folder's delta pages this run (including ones already known from a prior sweep).

messages_new.description: Messages discovered for the FIRST time this run (new `MailboxMessage` rows created).

evidence_created.description: New `EvidenceItem` rows successfully registered this run.

duplicates.description: Messages seen this run whose (mailbox_id, immutable_provider_message_id) already had a `MailboxMessage`/`EvidenceItem` — an idempotent re-observation (e.g. a re-seen page, or a message that moved folders), never double-ingested.

quarantined.description: Messages whose content-safety scan was not CLEAN — governed-quarantined, never parsed/classified.

failures.description: Messages that hit a transient, non-durably-handled failure this run (their folder's cursor is not advanced past them).

unique_sender_domains.description: Operational addendum (ahead of the first real large historical sweep). Count of distinct sender domains observed across every message seen this run (including duplicates/re-observations — Stage-A metadata is captured for every observed message regardless of dedup outcome).

allowed_domain_messages.description: Operational addendum. Messages this run whose sender domain had an `ALLOWED` `MailboxDomainRule` at the time they were processed (i.e. went through the Stage-B gate this run — a duplicate/already-final message short-circuits before the gate and is never counted here).

ignored_domain_messages.description: Operational addendum. Messages this run whose sender domain had an `IGNORED` `MailboxDomainRule` at the time they were processed.

unknown_domain_messages.description: Operational addendum. Messages this run with no governing `MailboxDomainRule` yet (candidate-evaluated by `services.mailbox.discovery_signals.evaluate_discovery_candidate`).

likely_financial_candidates.description: Operational addendum. Among `unknown_domain_messages`, how many `services.mailbox.discovery_signals.evaluate_discovery_candidate` judged a credible accounting-document candidate.

messages_with_attachments.description: Operational addendum. Messages this run whose Stage-A discovery metadata reported `has_attachments=True` (counted for every observed message, including duplicates).

graph_throttle_retries.description: Operational addendum. Count of Microsoft Graph `RATE_LIMITED` outcomes encountered and retried this run — both the whole-sweep folder-discovery call and every per-folder delta-page call.

error_code.description: Closed-vocabulary failure reason when `status` is `PARTIAL`/`FAILED` (see `services/mailbox/sweep.py::SweepFailureReason`). `null` for `RUNNING`/`SUCCEEDED`.

error_detail.description: Short, non-secret detail. NEVER a raw token/deltaLink/authorization code/OAuth state.
